name: singlet_qc_single_nucleus_quality_filtering
title: Nucleus-aware quality filtering (single-nucleus RNA-seq)
description: Flags compromised or incompletely stripped nuclei and writes obs/keep_cell, the nuclear fraction and flag reasons. The default method, mad_outlier, applies per-sample MAD rules to log counts, log genes and mito percent with a 0.5 percentage-point mito floor, the published nucleus practice. Use it on nucleus matrices with intronic counts, after nucleus-versus-empty calling. Do not use it on cell data (use qc.low_quality_cell_detection). Nuclear fraction is recorded as a covariate and never treated as damage.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Filter rule. mad_outlier is the default and published nucleus standard; the others are comparators.

nucleus_inputs.description: Column and layer mapping for nucleus inputs; applies to every method.

intronic_layer.description: Layer holding intronic (pre-mRNA) UMI counts per nucleus.

sample_key.description: obs column naming samples; thresholds are computed within each sample.

quantification.description: Pipeline and feature set that produced the intronic counts, such as STARsolo GeneFull; recorded in uns.

covariate_mode.description: covariate stores nuclear fraction and never flags on it; none skips computing it.

mad_outlier.description: Per-sample MAD rules; a nucleus is flagged beyond the median by max(nmads times MAD, min diff).

nmads_counts.description: MADs from the median for log total counts, both tails.

nmads_genes.description: MADs from the median for log genes detected, both tails.

nmads_mito.description: MADs above the median for mito percent, upper tail only.

mito_min_diff.description: Minimum distance above the median for mito outliers, in percentage points.

fixed_mito_cutoff.description: Single mito percent cutoff, used when method is fixed_mito_cutoff.

cutoff_percent.description: Mito percent cutoff; the default is an unbenchmarked toolkit value for nuclei.

miqc_mixture.description: Two-component mixture of mito percent on detected genes, used when method is miqc_mixture.

posterior_cutoff.description: Largest posterior probability of the compromised component that is kept.

dropletqc_nf.description: DropletQC damaged-cell gating on nuclear fraction and UMI, cell convention; used when method is dropletqc_nf.

nf_sep.description: Nuclear fraction separation for damaged calls, cell convention.

umi_sep_perc.description: UMI percentile separating damaged from intact calls, cell convention.

remove_flagged.description: Remove nuclei flagged as damaged; off by default because the convention inverts for nuclei.

dropkick.description: Elastic-net logistic classifier trained on heuristic labels; kept for comparison.

min_genes.description: Minimum genes per barcode before classification.

n_hvgs.description: Highly variable genes used as classifier features.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for miqc_mixture and dropkick fits; mad_outlier and fixed_mito_cutoff are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/keep_cell. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs: method, n_nuclei, n_kept, flags_by_reason, thresholds_by_sample, nuclear_fraction_summary. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
